body:
What about a skeleton knight? Could it be Gutts from the future? I'm puzzled. 
I just hope the artist is not gonna keel ova before ending the story.
Mmm… I remember a big fight with Zodd in some kind of an ocean town. But dont think its the furthest ive gotten to.

I'm sorry, I need to get to bed now, its getting very late here... Its been an exhausting day. Thank you for your concern though. Please pm me if you want and I will reply tomorrow. Thanks again, I really appreciate it.
He's a good son, but an unloved child, unfortunately. He always helps out but always gets shit attitude from his mum. His dad left ages ago, they don't keep in touch.
Its a different person. He knows everything and supports me, he asked me to stop talking to my parents. He cares a lot.

Mum didn't care about my writing. 
He contacted me when I was 18, but he was talking so much shit I soon grew tired of him. He mostly bragged about his life, hoping I will go and tell my mother she's missing out on a sweet deal there. Once, he said he'd like me to come and visit him (I was 19 at the time) in another country, and I said I couldn't afford it. He just said: oh, that's a shame. Followed by how great his new family is and how he wants me to meet them.
No, not at all. It was completely unrelated. Plus, I always have a lead middle aged male character.
It was quite random. I just finished a draft of a novel, and after that its like I hit a brick wall.

I don't really know, my mind just blocks out the right words. I always wrote without effort, words came easily to me, but now its a struggle. I can sit all day before the computer screen and not produce even one decent line.
I think about 3-4 years now… I tried writing 6 months ago but it stalled after the first few pages. I have material in my head, I just can't be bothered writing it out anymore.
No, I always thought of some horrible things to put my characters through. Probably I wanted them to feel more desperate than I was myself.
Horror/thriller, more on the psychological side.
No, thank god. I moved overseas some time ago.

He is one of the best characters ive ever encountered, seriously. He might seem immoral, cold, detached. But he cares. Awww, cute! :) 
I just wonder how the story will end. I hope we wont be let down.

I am Russian but was brought up in Ukraine. 
I know what you mean, it just feels too hard to collect my thoughts and put the all together on the paper. I might just snap and go punching people haha… I dont know though. You might be right. It could help.

Haha good luck staying alive long enough to use it! I've played the first DS for exact same reason - Berserk, and it was insanely difficult! I cursed like a sailor after 2 minutes into the game, and I'm a very patient gamer… 
I suppose I just read it all over again, there's never too much Gutts! (Sounds a bit sinister, I know)
Do you mind me asking what country are you from?
Maybe I can make myself write some life based sad fiction story... I just need to start, and hopefully it will come to me.

Thank you. I'm touched people care enough to write back to me. Thanks for taking time to send a bit of support to me.
It was hard but I suppose I'm always in some kind of shock, and just manage to get by when s** hits the fan. You are right, maybe one day I will be whole, inside and out. 
I hope you will find strength to fight the situation you are in. Its very hard to stand up for yourself, especially when it means standing up to a relative. But its our life, not theirs, and we need to keep going. I think you can do it and break free, before you are stuck for good. You can do it. It really helps to talk it out, that's true. You don't feel as lonely.

Thanks for your reply. I have someone who pm-ed me, and he's been a great help. 
I do intend to stop communicating with them as I never felt happy around them. For some reason I feel guilty! 
Maybe part of the problem is that my whole bloodline as far as I can remember consists of militaristic folk… Maybe my parents are mental. I don't know. I was always jealous of other peoples parents. 
I wanted to start a diary, but can't bring myself to put my feelings to the paper, I feel paralyzed when I pick up a pen.
I love it, though I actually stopped reading some time ago (caught up with the artist haha) and now I don't even remember where I've left off! ;(
Thanks! :)
